tool.name: Beacon2 Bracket Query
tool.description: find copy number and structural variants with imprecise breakpoints
tool.command: #if str($connection.transport) == "api" beacon2-query bracket @PROVIDER_ARGS@ @VARIANT_CLASS_ARGS@ --reference-name '$reference_name' --assembly '$assembly' --start-min $start_min --start-max $start_max --end-min $end_min --end-max $end_max --granularity '$granularity' --limit $pagination.limit --skip $pagination.skip @SAMPLE_ARGS@ @CNV_TERM_ARGS@ @SV_TERM_ARGS@ #if str($advanced.variant_min_length) --variant-min-length $advanced.variant_min_length #end if #if str($advanced.variant_max_length) --variant-max-length $advanced.variant_max_length #end if #if str($advanced.allow_degradation) == "false" --no-degradation #end if @FILTER_ARGS@ @OUTPUT_ARGS@ #else beacon2-query bracket --transport mongodb --db-host '$connection.db_host' --db-port $connection.db_port --database '$connection.database' --collection '$connection.collection' --credentials-file '$credentials' --reference-name '$reference_name' --start-min $start_min --start-max $start_max --end-min $end_min --end-max $end_max @CNV_TERM_ARGS@ @OUTPUT_ARGS@ #end if

param.label: Start of the start window
param.help: The variant's start must fall between this and the next value. Positions are 1-based.

param.label: Start of the end window
param.help: The variant's end must fall between this and the next value.

param.name: allow_degradation
param.label: Query beacons that lack bracket support
param.help: On: such beacons receive a widened range query instead, and every affected row is marked. Off: they are skipped and listed in the run report. Turn this off when comparing results between providers, because a widened query matches more variants.
